best_transferable_idea: One layered stat stack per category: strongest power shows, weaker copies wait in lower layers and surface when the top one expires; the death debt eases back through a level-scaled XP pool.
parity_row: row 1 (duel step/sim) for the layered stack; death debt is a separate idea for row 17 (death/respawn)
rule: Adding: entries in the same category are walked strongest first. Higher power surpasses; equal power with the same spell refreshes; equal power with a different spell: longer duration surpasses (permanent = infinite), equal duration falls back to spell id. A new layer is added above the top unless it refreshes; a refresh extends only when the new cast lasts longer than what remains. Top layer per category: highest power, then level-8 self-aura precedence, then newest start time. Clock: start time counts from 0 down to minus duration; heartbeat subtracts the interval; expiry when reached. DoT: top-layer entries tick each heartbeat; total is per-tick value times ceiling(duration over heartbeat). Dispel: filter by power, school and beneficial or harmful, exclude permanent, random count, shuffle, take. Vitae: death adds a 5 percent penalty value, floored at 40 percent, floor by level (level minus one, times 3, minimum 1); recovery pool costs (level^2.5 times 2.5 plus 20) times vitae^5 plus 0.5 XP per point; pool reset on death.
keep: Layered category stack with a top-layer rule (strongest power, then newest)
Refresh extends only when the new cast lasts longer than what remains
Clock counts to minus duration; permanent entries never expire by the check
